observations.content: Confirmed Paseo bug matches user's symptoms exactly: issue #3845 (extension sendMessage with triggerTurn:true leaves agent stuck running, spinner keeps spinning, persisted status running) and #3847 (extension-triggered autonomous turns emit turn_started but never turn_completed; explicitly names pi-subagents completion notifications).

Fix PRs #3848 and #3849 (settle autonomous Pi turns triggered by extensions) exist; verified via GitHub API both still OPEN, not merged, not in user's stable 0.6.1 nor 0.7.0-beta.2, so upgrading now does not fix this bug.
User's daemon is Paseo 0.6.1; latest stable 0.6.1 and 0.7.0-beta.2 (Aug 28) do not include the autonomous-turn fix.

Root trigger on user's machine found: observational-memory extension compaction-trigger.ts line 103 fires pi.sendMessage({customType: OM_RESUME, content: RESUME_PROMPT, display: false}, {triggerTurn: true}) after mid-run compaction to resume the agent; context at 86% threshold makes compaction fire after nearly every turn, causing repeated zombies (21:05, 21:18, 21:21).

observational-memory timeline-message.ts:61 sends pi.sendMessage with triggerTurn:false and a comment calling it load-bearing; subagent-types extension uses NO triggerTurn at all, so only OM's compaction resume uses the hazardous path.

Assistant recommended workaround: keep STOP (safe, matches daemon's own force-cancel), follow PR #3849 and upgrade on merge; considered flipping OM triggerTurn to false but advised against it since that would stop agent mid-task after compaction, only to avoid a cosmetic zombie.
User's 'stop then it runs again' behavior is explained: sending another message eventually forces Paseo to force-cancel a stale autonomous turn, matching the issue reports.

User asked assistant to draft a comment for issue #3845 with extra repro info but WITHOUT personal info, code, or details of their current project, and to show the comment for review before sending; also asked to research whether using the Anthropic API reduces the MiniMax-M3 thinking leak described earlier.

MiniMax M3 offers an Anthropic-compatible endpoint: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to https://api.minimax.io/anthropic (China: https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic), use subscription key as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, model MiniMax-M3[1m], POST to /anthropic/v1/messages.

With Anthropic Messages format MiniMax-M3 returns thinking as separate content blocks (type: thinking/text/tool_use) via thinking={type: adaptive}; preserve response.content exactly when appending assistant message for multi-turn continuity.

With OpenAI-compatible API MiniMax-M3 thinking leaks into content field inside thinking tags unless extra_body reasoning_split:true is set, which moves thinking into reasoning_details; also the API may occasionally place the start of the final answer inside the thinking block.

Related known issues found: earendil-works/pi#7155 (MiniMax-M3 thinking content leaks into assistant text response, still in 0.82.1), pi#8839 (pi anthropic-messages provider fails with Cannot read properties of undefined reading properties when using Minimax API), MiniMax-M3#28 (answer truncated after stripping reasoning), MiniMax-M2#105 (SSE thinking tags mixed in content field), vllm#45687 (mm:think in content field in streaming), Kilo-Org/kilocode#11203, MiniMax-M2.7#46 (anthropic endpoint reports 200K context instead of 1M causing early compaction), anthropics/claude-code#46416 (context window detection fails for third-party Anthropic-compatible providers).
